stoppingDecision.assessment: Three related fields offer substantive, distinct responses to Groningen Medicine. Biomedical science has the strongest scientific overlap. Health psychology studies illness experience and interaction, and population health studies prevention and inequality. The professional and clinical curriculum remains a separate feature of Medicine.

analysis: Biomedical science progresses from cell biology, anatomy, physiology and biochemistry to immune mechanisms, organ pathology, pharmacology, molecular genetics and laboratory work. Probability, numerical methods and research synthesis develop transferable analytical skills without implying medical practice. Health psychology progresses from brain and social psychology to health behaviour, psychological assessment and communication, with qualitative methods and research synthesis. Leadership and AI ethics support context, and do not establish patient consultation, interprofessional competencies or healthcare innovation training. Description-only Behavioral Economics contributes decision bias, heuristics and experiments. Population health progresses from epidemiology and sociology to prevention, inequalities, ageing, public economics and description-supported econometrics in causal and predictive analysis. Description-only Environmental Justice adds comparative case work and social movement theory; it supplies environmental and equity context, not medical exposure assessment. Each retained option differs in research questions and course spine. The case has only three coherent target-related concepts at this breadth. Community labels describe Groningen’s training contexts and do not warrant additional UCR programmes built around clinical practice. Removed weak alignments to clinical competency and retained five specifically supported biomedical or psychological alignments. Groningen’s patient care, exams, supervised practice and competency programme remain separate.
